halves_note_awarded_match: Match 4271663 (2023/2024, FK Radnicki 1923 vs FK Crvena Zvezda) was an awarded 0-3 win: FT goals 3 but 7 Goal events (5 in 1H). Its event 1H count exceeds its FT total, so it is excluded from the frozen halves_goals_dev share; the inclusive value is reported separately as halves_goals_dev_incl_awarded.

halves_yellows_dev_note: Dev event yellows total 13 first-half cards on 108 cards overall (see inventory); the 1H share is computed on that near-empty feed and is NOT a usable frozen constant for a cards product.

dev_medians.note: no dev medians for SOT/corners/shots/yellows: no stats feed in dev and the event cards feed is broken (YellowRed-only); no primary line can be set from dev for S/C/K/T

qualification_matches.note: 2-legged relegation/promotion play-off ties: a Super Liga club vs a Prva Liga (tier 2) club. Cross-tier rows; the design doc excludes them from fitting (see MODEL_DESIGN). They stay in rs_matches.csv with phase=qualification and in the levels table, but out of halves_goals_dev_league_only and out of the X2 entrant measurement.

x2_entrant_gf_ga_diff_vs_league_team_mea.note: dev transitions only (2022/2023-2024/2025); the 2025/2026 entrant is listed in x2_entrants for inventory but its performance is not measured

2025/2026.note: rich-era-only check (stats yellows exist only in the virgin season); the stats feed NEVER exceeds events here -- it systematically undercounts yellows vs the event feed

team_ids_note: 25 distinct team ids in dev+virgin rows. The pre-findings figure of 27 counts the full CSV including the reserve season 2026/2027, which this script excludes; 2 ids appear only in the reserve season and are not enumerated here.
